title: BARISTA: BARrier Inference of Sequential, Tunnelling and Activated transport
description: BARISTA identifies the charge-transport mechanism across thin insulating, semiconducting, molecular or magnetic barriers from current-voltage data at one or more temperatures and thicknesses. It fits tunnelling, trap-assisted, hopping, emission and space-charge-limited mechanisms globally, ranks them with information criteria, cross-validation and plausibility checks, quantifies uncertainty by bootstrap and profile likelihood, extracts trap densities and energies, covers spin-dependent transport, and writes manuscript-ready figures, tables and Methods text.
